data.sections.movement.movementType.desc: Defines what kind of terrain the unit will be able to move, along with other properties. Can use only one: NONE, LAND, AIR, WATER, HOVER, BUILDING, OVER_CLIFF, OVER_CLIFF_WATER
data.sections.movement.slowDeathFall.des: Used with large aircraft. Makes the unit fall slowly while maintaining its speed at the time of death.
data.sections.movement.moveSpeed.descrip: Maximum movement speed of the unit. A value of 1 means (1 pixel * 60) per second (or 3 tiles per second)
data.sections.movement.moveAccelerationS: Defines how fast units accelerate to max speed.
data.sections.movement.moveDecelerationS: Don't make this too low or units will have trouble stopping at waypoints
data.sections.movement.reverseSpeedPerce: 0.6 default. Over 0.4 will reverse for short distances (at 40% speed). If set to 1 will drive in reverse same as forwards. Useful if slow turning
data.sections.movement.landOnGround.desc: Should flying unit land when idle.
data.sections.movement.targetHeight.desc: Defaults to 0 but if AIR movementType default is 35
data.sections.movement.targetHeightDrift: Smooth animated height change. Defaults to 0 but if AIR movementType default is 1.5
data.sections.movement.startingHeightOff: Sets the initial height on spawn. Defaults at 0.
Rate at which the unit changes height, either from converting or drifting
data.sections.movement.fallingAccelerati: The acceleration in which a unit drops
data.sections.movement.maxTurnSpeed.desc: Sets the top turning speed of a unit
Defines how fast units accelerate to max turn speed.
data.sections.movement.moveSlidingMode.d: Makes the unit slide when moveDecelerationSpeed is lower, making them drift and feel natural
Allows the unit to move without fully turning in the direction its moving, useful for ships and air units
data.sections.movement.joinsGroupFormati: Defaults to true. Changing not recommended. When false, the unit will directly move to the assigned waypoint without taking space consideration from neighboring units.
